# DuckDuckGo
> The Internet privacy company offering private search, browsing, and privacy tools to help protect personal information online.

DuckDuckGo provides privacy-focused products including private search, a web browser, browser extensions, tracking protection tools, and consumer privacy resources. Its site includes product pages, help documentation, developer resources, blog content, and legal and policy information.

## Core Products
- [Private Search](https://duckduckgo.com/): Privacy-focused search engine that avoids tracking and profiling users.
- [Windows Browser](https://duckduckgo.com/windows): Private browser for Windows with built-in privacy protections.
- [Mac Browser](https://duckduckgo.com/mac): Private browser for macOS focused on simpler everyday privacy.
- [Browser Extensions](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/desktop/adding-duckduckgo-to-your-browser/): Information on adding DuckDuckGo protections to desktop browsers.
- [Email Protection](https://duckduckgo.com/email): Free email forwarding service that removes many hidden email trackers.
- [App Tracking Protection](https://duckduckgo.com/app): Android privacy feature that blocks third-party trackers in apps.

## Help Center
- [Help Home](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages): Central help hub for DuckDuckGo products and features.
- [Search Help](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/): Help articles about search results, features, and behavior.
- [Browser Help](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/desktop/): Support documentation for DuckDuckGo desktop browser features.
- [Mobile Help](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/mobile/): Support content for DuckDuckGo mobile apps and protections.
- [Privacy Essentials Help](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/): Documentation for privacy protections and browsing safeguards.
- [Email Protection Help](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/email-protection/): Guides and troubleshooting for DuckDuckGo Email Protection.

## Search Features
- [Bangs](https://duckduckgo.com/bangs): Shortcut syntax for searching directly on thousands of other sites.
- [Search Syntax](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/syntax/): Operators and syntax supported in DuckDuckGo search queries.
- [Instant Answers](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/instant-answers/): Overview of answer modules shown directly in search results.
- [Safe Search](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/safe-search/): Controls for filtering explicit content from search results.
- [Maps](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/duckduckgo-maps/): Information about map results and location-related search features.
- [News Results](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/news/): Details on how news content appears in DuckDuckGo search.

## Privacy Tools and Protections
- [Privacy Dashboard](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/web-tracking-protections/): Overview of tracking protections used while browsing.
- [Cookie Pop-Up Protection](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/cookie-pop-up-protection/): Feature that helps reduce cookie consent pop-up interruptions.
- [Global Privacy Control](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/gpc/): Support for sending privacy preference signals to participating websites.
- [Tracker Radar](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/web-tracking-protections/duckduckgo-tracker-radar/): Information about DuckDuckGo’s tracker dataset and protections.
- [Fire Button](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/mobile/fire-button/): One-tap tool for clearing tabs and browsing data.
- [Privacy Grade](https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/privacy-grade/): Explanation of site privacy grades shown in DuckDuckGo products.

## Developer Resources
- [Developers](https://duckduckgo.com/developers): Entry point for DuckDuckGo developer tools and integrations.
- [Instant Answer API](https://duckduckgo.com/api): Simple API for retrieving DuckDuckGo Instant Answer data.
- [Goodies Overview](https://duckduckhack.com/): Community and development hub for DuckDuckGo Instant Answers.
- [DuckDuckHack Documentation](https://docs.duckduckhack.com/): Technical documentation for building and maintaining Instant Answers.
- [Spice Reference](https://docs.duckduckhack.com/walkthroughs/calculation-spice.html): Example technical reference for API-backed Instant Answer components.
- [Fathead Reference](https://docs.duckduckhack.com/walkthroughs/fathead-overview.html): Documentation for static-data Instant Answer backends.
